verdict.rationale: Mem0 offers a Memory Export feature with customizable Pydantic schemas, an open-source self-hosted version giving full data ownership, and a CLI for add/search/list/update/delete — all supporting data portability. However, there's no explicit documentation of a full bulk export-everything-and-leave workflow or standardized open format (e.g., JSON/CSV dump of the entire memory store) beyond schema-based exports. missing for 10: a documented full-account bulk export mechanism in a standard open format, explicit guidance for migrating away/deleting all platform data, and independent confirmation that exports are complete and portable.
